title: EXP-100 - Hello World Part 6 Section 8: Extend Theme FX_HelloWorld (Form Font Tahoma, Flex Layout Class FX_BlueBackground, Static Classes FX_WhiteHeader and FX_Header), Readback After Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 8 (07:34-09:36), adapted to FX_ names: in the Web Designer open Edit > Theme, edit the factory theme FX_HelloWorld (EXP-064) and record its Edit Styles tree read-only first. Then set the Form element Font Family to Tahoma; add the Flex Layout class FX_BlueBackground with Background Color #FF5CC6C7; add the Static class FX_WhiteHeader with Font Size 16, Bold True and Normal State Foreground Solid White; add the Static class FX_Header with Font Size 16 and Bold True. Commit with Edit Styles OK, Global Objects OK and one Designer Save, then verify every value by reopening the theme editor read-only. Only FX_HelloWorld changes; FX_BlueButton and every other theme stay as they are. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt6.md Section 8 and its transcript lines (07:34-09:36), recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-064, EXP-065 and EXP-099 records (EXP-064 holds the proven theme-editor method). Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved runtime change open across tasks. Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope; no Form is open, or any open Form is clean (Save and Undo disabled). If a Form is dirty or the session shows the server-event error, record it and stop blocked.

Theme discovery (read-only): open the Designer Edit menu once and choose Theme once. Record the Themes list and confirm FX_HelloWorld exists. Select FX_HelloWorld and use Edit once. In Edit Styles record the Elements tree path of Form, FlexLayout and Static and every existing child class under FlexLayout and Static; select the Form element and record its Categories and the Font attributes with their current values (Font Family, Font Size, Bold and any others); select FlexLayout and Static and record their Categories and the attribute that holds the background color; select FX_BlueButton under Button and record its Normal State Foreground and Background. Selection clicks only. If FX_BlueBackground, FX_WhiteHeader or FX_Header already exists, or FX_HelloWorld is missing, record it and stop blocked. Leave Edit Styles with Cancel once and Global Objects with Cancel once; record any prompt (answer No) and the Designer state afterwards.

Form font: open Edit > Theme, FX_HelloWorld, Edit once more. Select the Form element and its Font category, and set Font Family to Tahoma (choose Tahoma from the control's list if it offers one, otherwise type Tahoma and press Tab once). Record the readback. Change no other Form attribute.

Flex Layout class: select FlexLayout, enter FX_BlueBackground in Class Name and use Add once. The tree refreshes (EXP-064): reselect FlexLayout, expand it if needed, and select FX_BlueBackground. Record its Categories, choose the one that holds Background Color, type #FF5CC6C7 exactly into the Background field and press Tab once; record the readback verbatim. Do not use the color picker for this value.

Static class FX_WhiteHeader: select Static, enter FX_WhiteHeader in Class Name and use Add once; reselect Static and FX_WhiteHeader. In its Font category set Font Size to 16 and Bold to True (record each control type and any unit shown). In its Normal State category open the Foreground field's own picker button once, choose Solid by clicking the visible Solid label text (EXP-064: the radio input itself can time out), accept the default White exactly as offered, record the picker values, confirm with the picker OK once, and record the Foreground readback (expected #FFFFFFFF).

Static class FX_Header: select Static, enter FX_Header in Class Name and use Add once; reselect Static and FX_Header; in its Font category set Font Size to 16 and Bold to True. Leave every other attribute of all three new classes at its default. At most one correction per field.

From the first change until the commit step, keep Edit Styles and Global Objects open: never Cancel or close either dialog with unsaved theme changes. Verify by selection that all four changes are present before committing.

Commit: Edit Styles OK once, then Global Objects OK once, then exactly one Designer toolbar Save only if it is enabled; record each native response verbatim (EXP-064: "Global object(s) were saved."). If Save stays disabled, record it and stop blocked. Never retry a Save.

Readback (read-only): open Edit > Theme, FX_HelloWorld, Edit once more and verify by selection: Form Font Family Tahoma; FX_BlueBackground Background #FF5CC6C7; FX_WhiteHeader Font Size 16, Bold True, Normal State Foreground #FFFFFFFF; FX_Header Font Size 16, Bold True; FX_BlueButton Normal State Background #FF5CC6C7 and Foreground #FFFFFFFF (unchanged). Leave Edit Styles with Cancel once and Global Objects with Cancel once; verify no prompt and Save disabled.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the Themes list, the Edit Styles tree before any change, the Form Font attributes before and after Tahoma, each class add (before and after reselecting), each class's values after entry, the Foreground picker before its OK, all values before the commit, each commit response, and each readback. notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-099.
